_README: TEMPLATE for .secrets.local.json — the LOCAL-POSTURE credential store
(d.s Stage 3). Copy to .secrets.local.json and edit. That filename is
gitignored AND refused by the kit's no-secrets guard, so it can never be
committed or ride to another machine. This example file is tracked and
must never contain a real value.
You do not need to create it by hand for the console to work: the
operator service mints its own local identity on first use and logs the
console in with no credential to record or paste. Create it only when you
have a CONNECTOR credential to enter — the one thing a human still
supplies, because those are real third-party secrets.
In DEPLOYED posture (KH_POSTURE=deployed) this file is never opened; the
same two piles live in OpenBao at tenants/<tenant>/sources/<ref> and
'principals' is keyed on the sha256 of the credential, never the value —
which is also why a token can never be read back out of the store. Leave
that section alone; khctl provision-operator / provision-agent write it.
